Table: Mean Opacities for [M/H] = -0.3

Byte-by-byte Description of file: datafile3.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units     Label                   Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1-  4 I4     K         Temp      Gas temperature 
   6- 10 E5.0   0.1PA     Pressure  Gas pressure in units of dyne/cm^2^ 
  12- 21 E10.4  g/cm^3    Density   Gas density (1)
  23- 32 E10.4  cm^2/g    kappaR    Rosseland mean opacity (1)
  34- 43 E10.4  cm^2/g    kappaP    Planck mean opacity (1)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): For [M/H] = -0.3, compared to solar abundances of Lodders (2003).
